summary: Local source/rules audit covers verified admission, protected membership, role/ownership checks, stale privileged claims, workflow races, staff transfer and permit-gated private media. Live deployment/attestation and external policy/configuration gates prevent production security certification.

findings.issue: Server-issued upload permits, a daily per-user image budget and exact callable quotas are implemented. Firebase Authentication signup abuse controls, orphan cleanup and project-wide cost budgets remain external or incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Configure approved Authentication protections, budget alerts and orphan cleanup before a pilot. Validate permits with production App Check and Storage enforcement.

findings.issue: Suspension, student deletion and same-role staff responsibility transfer/deactivation are implemented and locally tested. Production deletion is intentionally disabled pending approved retention and activation.
findings.recommendation: Validate the staff workflow with approved operators and current production records. Use the trusted suspension workflow and obtain policy approval before activating production deletion.

findings.issue: The read-only production Firestore request returned SERVICE_DISABLED. Live rules/indexes, App Check, FCM and Crashlytics receipt remain unverified.
findings.recommendation: Execute the reviewed release runbook after explicit billing, regions, deployment and signing authorization; validate live negative-permission and attestation cases.

findings.issue: Exact-domain verified-email admission and email-bound exceptions are implemented. An email domain does not prove student status or authorize institutional processing.
findings.recommendation: Keep roles server-provisioned and exceptions tied to institution-approved references. Confirm controller/publisher, Civora contacts, current campus records and authorization before a live pilot.
